summary:
Stage 11 test (FMST26, fmOS and FM Dossier ideas). Setup was TEST_career with 3 saves read. Wrote a new pytest file, test_fmcc_stage11_lab.py: 33/35 pass, and the 2 failures are real bugs. Stage 10 regression: 42/42 pass (the DOF test was left out). UI tested with Playwright at 1920 and 768.

Working:
- Guided tour: starts by itself the first time, runs 14 steps, each page opens with its menu item highlighted (Game changes highlights top-changes-button). Back, Next and Skip work. It ends on 'You're ready', Finish sets fmcc-tour-done and goes Home, and it doesn't come back after a reload. Replay works from top-tour-button and settings-take-tour.
- Formulas: live preview, the errors 'Unknown stat: foo.' and 'Only min, max, abs and if…' for __import__(1), key cleaned to lowercase, save, edit (version 2), chaining with f_, cycle and self-reference refused (422), delete blocked when another formula uses it (409 toast 'Used by TEST_chain'), limit of 30 (409), export JSON download, import JSON, and a bad file shows a toast.
- Formulas show up in the Players 'Formulas (n)' columns, the Scatter x/y axes, the Quadrant select, the advanced filter fields and /scout/meta.
- Advanced filter: AND/OR, nested group, value, stat vs stat and percentile conditions (203 to 22 players). The button shows '(on)'. It is saved with saved searches and comes back when the search is loaded. Heat colours work.
- Quadrant on Deals & Offers shows the 4 zones; clicking a dot opens the profile.
- Profile: Find a replacement (fee and age caps send the request and filter the list; clicking a row opens that player). Price explained (Potential hidden in Fair play and Moneyball; no 500 for any of 203 players in full or fair). The history chart shows when there are 2 seasons (I added a TEST stat_history doc to check this).
- Tactic fit: 11 slot cards with starter, backup and depth; 4-3-3 and 4-2-3-1; 3 gaps; shape advisor; save tactic; .fmf import ('4-2-3-1' text works, garbage gives a 422 toast, .txt gives 422). Unknown formation gives 404.
- Connections apps-card: FM Dossier 'Get it' goes to https://fmdossier.dev/. FMST26 and fmOS show 'No official page set'. A path without .exe gives 422 toast, an .exe path saves, Open gives 409 toast.
- Settings > Updates: FM Dossier shows 'You update it yourself' with v1.15.3 and a Download page link (/download). FMST26 and fmOS show 'No release page yet'. None of the 3 has Update now. Credits list all 3.
- Home: welcome band, 3x2 equal cards, Needs your attention and Next match as two equal halves (775px each). At 768 there's no horizontal scroll.
- Regression: Squad tabs (lineup, depth, players, registration, rules) and Editor tabs work, with no page errors.

critical.endpoint: POST /api/scout/players (sort and adv filter) in view=fair|moneyball
critical.issue: Hidden information leaks. lab_api.value() and scout_api._value_of() fall back to x.get(field), so adv {field:'pa', cmp:'>=', value:170} with view=fair filters on the hidden PA (34 of 203 players returned). sort='pa' in Fair play also orders rows by the true PA (the same top 5 as Full, with pa masked to None). Whitelist the fields (minutes, age, value, wage, grade, METRICS, c:, f:) and refuse ca/pa and hidden attributes outside Full.

A non-numeric condition value (for example value:'abc') makes float(b) raise in lab_api.match, and the API returns 500. Validate the adv tree with Pydantic or catch it and return 422. Nesting depth isn't limited either: the UI stops at 2 levels, but the API recurses with no limit.

minor.issue: stats_model.similar has no gender filter. A men's full-back (Caio Souza) gets women's players as replacements (Fenna Smit, Northbridge Athletic Women). Add o['gender'] == x['gender'].
Items include internal fields (career_id, id, status, at). Leave them out.
max_value=0 or max_age=0 is treated as no cap (the checks are truthy). Use 'is not None'.

Not atomic and order-dependent. It saves one by one, so a file where A uses f_B with B listed later fails halfway with 422, after the earlier ones are already saved. Sort by dependency first, or check everything before saving.

The Position detail prints a raw number ('valued at 13,000,000') with no currency and ignores the currency pref. med() indexes [len(peers)//2] into a filtered list that can be shorter: no crash was seen on sample data, but it's fragile.
Tactic gaps are always worked out for a hard-coded 433, not the user's latest saved or imported tactic.

ui_bugs.component: PlayersTab BASE.group / Tactic fit Squad gaps
ui_bugs.issue: Clicking a squad gap goes to /scouting?group=FB, but the Players table is NOT filtered (sp-group is empty, 203 players). BASE is a module-level constant that reads window.location.search once, when the app first loads. It only works on a hard load of the URL, and after that the first URL's group sticks for every later visit to /scouting. Read the param with useSearchParams inside the component (initial state, plus an effect when it changes).

max.p = Math.max(1, ...perfs). When the formula values are all below 1 (for example 'npg - npxg', max 0.4), the Hidden gems and Stars ReferenceAreas reach past the y domain, recharts drops them, and only Avoid and Overpriced show. Use the real max (and min) of perf, or set ifOverflow='extendDomain'.

After saving, the old preview stays under the now-empty form. Edit doesn't re-run the preview, so if the last check was an error, Save stays disabled until the user types. Clear prev on save and call check(x.expr) on Edit.
Only 433 and 4231 are hard-coded. Build the options from the API (shapes) so new formations or imports always match.

issues: The sidebar is hidden and there's no menu button, so the only way to reach other pages is the Ctrl K search or links on Home
Scout tab bar labels wrap ('Deals &' is cut off)
The copy still says 'ranked by role fit… Open rankings' (old wording; it should describe ScoutSheet)
The strength number has no label, and both shapes show 70 with only 'depth' to tell them apart

action_items: Whitelist the sort and adv filter fields per view (no ca, pa or hidden attributes in Fair play or Moneyball)
Validate the adv tree (numeric values, max depth) so bad input gives 422 instead of 500
Fix the squad-gap pre-filter: read ?group= in PlayersTab with useSearchParams, not a module-level BASE
Fix the Quadrant top zones vanishing when perf < 1 (max.p floor of 1)
Add a gender filter to stats_model.similar (replacement and similar players)
Make formulas import dependency-ordered and all-or-nothing; leave career_id and other internal fields out of GET /scout/formulas
Minor: clear or refresh the formula preview on save and edit; build the formation select from the API; currency format in Price explained; mobile/tablet navigation
critical_code_review_comments: lab_api.value / scout_api._value_of are near-duplicates (DRY). Both fall back to x.get(field), which causes the leak above.
lab_api.match uses unvalidated dict input (adv: Optional[dict]). Define Pydantic models for Cond and Group.
pct_of imports bisect inside the function. Move it to module level.
tactic_fit and shapes crash with a TypeError (500) when latest_snapshot is None (no save read yet). Guard it and return 404.
fit() rates every player for every slot, so the same player can start in two slots (known and by design). Shape advisor strength is identical for both formations on the sample data.

success_rate.frontend: ~90% (all requested flows work except the squad-gap pre-filter and the Quadrant top zones for formulas below 1)

seed_data_creation: Used the existing TEST_career (3 saves). Created TEST_ formulas, TEST_ saved search, TEST_ tactics, a TEST stat_history row for the 2026/27 season (to show the history chart) and an fmst26/fmdossier app path. At the end all collections were dropped (the main agent allowed this) and /app/backend/preview_fm was deleted, so the DB is now empty.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Setup: POST /api/setup/complete {name:'TEST_career', club_name:'Sample Club FC', edition:'FM27', save_folder:'C:\\TEST_folder'} then POST /api/saves/read 2 to 3 times. Run with: pytest tests/test_fmcc_stage11_lab.py -p no:xdist -o addopts=''. In Playwright, set localStorage fmcc-tour-done=1 and then page.goto: on a first visit the tour sends you to '/'. Testids used: tour-*, formula-*, sp-adv-toggle, adv-add-0/adv-add-group-0/adv-group-1/adv-apply, quadrant-card/quadrant-perf, profile-find-replacement, repl-*, price-explained, profile-history-chart, tactic-*, fit-slot-*, gap-*, shape-advisor, apps-card, app-*, update-row-*, update-download-fmdossier. No LLM calls were made.
rca of the issue: Gap pre-filter: PlayersTab.jsx line 10, `const BASE = {..., group: new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get('group')}`, is evaluated once when the module is imported (Scouting is imported eagerly in App.js), so SPA navigation never re-reads ?group=. PA leak: _value_of(x, 'pa') reaches the last line, x.get('pa'), on the unmasked player dict, before mask() is applied in _row. Quadrant: ReferenceArea y2 = max(1, maxPerf) falls outside the auto y-domain, and recharts's default ifOverflow='discard' hides those areas.
